newForms.name: Clodrunner
newForms.lore: Ploughs a straight furrow at a dead sprint. Don't ask how.

newForms.name: Ploughmane
newForms.lore: Its mane looks like tilled soil because, functionally, it is.

newForms.name: Earthmarch
newForms.lore: Villages reroute roads around where it likes to walk.

newForms.name: Cloudmane
newForms.lore: Gallops so lightly its hoofprints don't survive the landing.

newForms.name: Galemane
newForms.lore: Outruns storms it starts by running.

newForms.name: Zephyrsteed
newForms.lore: The wind doesn't carry it. It carries the wind.

newForms.name: Ironhoof
newForms.lore: Every step sounds like a door slamming. On purpose.

newForms.name: Grandbull
newForms.lore: The Vale's biggest plough pulls itself now, thanks.

newForms.name: Titanbull
newForms.lore: When it puts its head down, smart Mystics reconsider their plans.

newForms.name: Cinderox
newForms.lore: Its snort comes out as a small localized weather event.

newForms.name: Forgeox
newForms.lore: Blacksmiths pay well just to stand near it on cold mornings.

newForms.name: Vulcanox
newForms.lore: Legends disagree on whether it started the Scar's fires or just refuses to let them go out.

newForms.name: Trufflenose
newForms.lore: Can smell a good mushroom through solid rock. Probably.

newForms.name: Boarloam
newForms.lore: Digs treasure pits so tidy the diggers get complimented.

newForms.name: Goldtusker
newForms.lore: Its tusks have found more lost rings than the lost-and-found.

newForms.name: Trufflemonarch
newForms.lore: Every good mushroom in the Vale is, technically, on loan from it.

newForms.name: Slumberfleece
newForms.lore: Its wool is so soft that shears fall asleep mid-cut.

newForms.name: Dreamwool
newForms.lore: Naps standing up, sitting down, and occasionally mid-stride.

newForms.name: Reverieram
newForms.lore: Butts heads only in dreams. The dreams are very convincing.

newForms.name: Dreamshepherd
newForms.lore: Herds other Mystics into naps for their own good. Mostly works.

newForms.name: Permarf
newForms.lore: Its howl starts blizzards. Its wag ends friendships with anyone downwind.

newForms.name: Aurorarf
newForms.lore: Runs so far north the sky starts putting on a show for it specifically.

newForms.name: Barbnet
newForms.lore: Its stinger now has a stinger. Don't ask, just don't.

newForms.name: Venomnet
newForms.lore: Its hive hums a warning long before it does.

newForms.name: Hivemonarch
newForms.lore: Every stinger in the Vale answers to one buzz from it.

newForms.name: Gnawglint
newForms.lore: Its cheeks are 40% storage space, 60% opinions about shiny objects.

newForms.name: Hoardrat
newForms.lore: Its burrow has more rooms than most inns, all of them full.

newForms.name: Vaultgnaw
newForms.lore: Digs vaults so secure even it sometimes forgets the way in.

newForms.name: Coinlord
newForms.lore: Sits on a throne of found coins and mismatched buttons like it's the Vale's Crown Jewels.

prompts.name: Trotlet
prompts.prompt: A stocky young foal with stubby legs and a sandy-brown coat, kicking up small clods of dirt as it trots in wobbly circles, pleased with itself.

prompts.name: Loamstrider
prompts.prompt: A sturdy working horse with a broad chest and deep umber coat, powerful legs built for hauling, calm intelligent eyes and dust always clinging to its fetlocks.

prompts.name: Clodrunner
prompts.prompt: A leaner, faster-built horse with a rich brown coat and rocky nodules embedded along its fetlocks like natural horseshoes, throwing up a visible trail of clods at a run.

prompts.name: Ploughmane
prompts.prompt: A grand draft horse with a heavy mane textured like tilled furrows of dark soil, deep brown coat and stone-plated fetlocks, radiating calm working-class strength.

prompts.name: Earthmarch
prompts.prompt: A colossal earthen warhorse whose furrowed soil-mane has become a rolling ridge of stone and root down its neck, deep umber-bronze coat with glowing amber seams in its hooves, each stride leaving the ground visibly reshaped.

prompts.name: Trotlet
prompts.prompt: A stocky young foal with stubby legs and a sandy-brown coat, kicking up small clods of dirt as it trots in wobbly circles, pleased with itself.

prompts.name: Skymane
prompts.prompt: A pale, elegant horse whose mane drifts like trailing cloud, near-white coat with a faint sky-blue sheen, hooves that barely seem to touch the ground.

prompts.name: Cloudmane
prompts.prompt: A leaner sky-horse whose cloud-mane now billows constantly around its neck and shoulders, pale blue-white coat brightening at the edges, cantering just above the grass.

prompts.name: Galemane
prompts.prompt: A powerful sky-steed with a full flowing mane of living cloud-wisp, bright pale-blue coat streaked in glowing cyan along its flanks, a constant soft gale trailing its gallop.

prompts.name: Zephyrsteed
prompts.prompt: A majestic sky-sovereign horse wreathed in a swirling mane and tail of living wind and cloud, luminous pale coat glowing faintly cyan at every edge, seeming to gallop just above the world entirely.

prompts.name: Moolet
prompts.prompt: A round young calf with short blunt horns and a warm caramel-brown hide, sturdy little legs and a contented expression, chewing thoughtfully.

prompts.name: Bullwark
prompts.prompt: A broad, muscular bull with thick curved horns and a deep umber hide, planted stance and a stubborn, immovable presence.

prompts.name: Ironhoof
prompts.prompt: An even broader bull whose hooves and horn-bases have hardened into iron-grey stone plating, dark umber hide with a heavier, more deliberate stance.

prompts.name: Grandbull
prompts.prompt: A massive bull armoured across its shoulders and horns in overlapping grey stone plates, near-black umber hide, radiating slow unstoppable weight.

prompts.name: Titanbull
prompts.prompt: A mountainous bull titan fully plated in dark fused stone across its head and shoulders, near-black hide glowing faintly at the seams, horns like carved standing stones — the ground itself seems to brace when it moves.

prompts.name: Moolet
prompts.prompt: A round young calf with short blunt horns and a warm caramel-brown hide, sturdy little legs and a contented expression, chewing thoughtfully.

prompts.name: Pyrox
prompts.prompt: A stout bull whose hide has scorched to a deep rust-red, horns smouldering faintly at the tips, snorting small curls of smoke.

prompts.name: Cinderox
prompts.prompt: A broader rust-red bull with cracked-ember patterning across its hide and brighter smouldering horns, faint heat-shimmer rising off its back.

prompts.name: Forgeox
prompts.prompt: A powerful bull armoured across its shoulders in dark cracked plates glowing orange at the seams like a forge, horns burning steadily, heat visibly rolling off it.

prompts.name: Vulcanox
prompts.prompt: A titanic volcanic bull whose obsidian-dark hide is seamed with rivers of glowing molten orange, horns wreathed in constant flame, radiating heat like a standing furnace.

prompts.name: Truffly
prompts.prompt: A round little piglet creature with a big sniffing snout and floppy ears, mossy brown fur speckled with dirt, nose buried in the undergrowth.

prompts.name: Trufflenose
prompts.prompt: A slightly bigger piglet with an even more prominent snout and small curling tusks just starting to show, mossy brown fur, digging with real enthusiasm.

prompts.name: Boarloam
prompts.prompt: A sturdy young boar with visible curling tusks and thicker bristled fur in mottled brown and moss-green, snout permanently caked in rich soil.

prompts.name: Goldtusker
prompts.prompt: A hefty boar with long, gleaming tusks and a dense mane of bristled brown-green fur, small glints of gold and treasure visible caught in its coat.

prompts.name: Trufflemonarch
prompts.prompt: A magnificent forest boar crowned in curling golden-sheened tusks and a thick regal mane of deep moss-brown bristles, draped faintly in trailing roots and tiny mushrooms like jewellery it earned.

prompts.name: Dozewool
prompts.prompt: A round, heavy-fleeced sheep creature with half-closed dreamy eyes and thick curling cream wool, moving at an unhurried drowsy pace.

prompts.name: Slumberfleece
prompts.prompt: A slightly larger sheep with even thicker, softer cream wool now tinged pale lavender at the curls, eyes perpetually half-lidded and content.

prompts.name: Dreamwool
prompts.prompt: A plush, heavy-bodied sheep whose lavender-cream wool has grown into deep drifting curls, faint dream-like sparkles drifting from its fleece as it dozes on its feet.

prompts.name: Reverieram
prompts.prompt: A grand ram with a magnificent curled horn pair and dense violet-cream fleece that seems to shimmer faintly like it's still half a dream, drowsy but immense.

prompts.name: Dreamshepherd
prompts.prompt: A towering, gentle ram-giant draped in luxuriant deep-violet wool that drifts with faint glowing motes like captured stardust, huge curled horns and half-lidded knowing eyes, radiating calm the way a hearth radiates warmth.

prompts.name: Snubbit
prompts.prompt: A small stout pug-like creature with a wrinkled snub nose and pale cream fur, snoring softly even while awake, a faint breeze curling off its stubby tail.

prompts.name: Gustail
prompts.prompt: A leaner, more athletic pug-dog with tan-and-cream fur and a tail that leaves small dust-devils spinning behind it, chasing itself with real enthusiasm.

prompts.name: Blizzarf
prompts.prompt: A sturdy husky-like dog with thick white-and-grey fur and icy-blue markings, breath visibly fogging, standing ready to pull a sled or start a blizzard.

prompts.name: Permarf
prompts.prompt: A powerful husky with a dense frost-pale coat and deeper icy-blue markings down its back, small drifts of snow swirling around its paws as it moves.

prompts.name: Aurorarf
prompts.prompt: A magnificent arctic wolf-dog whose thick white coat is streaked in glowing pale-cyan aurora patterns down its spine and tail, trailing swirling snow and faint colour with every bound.

prompts.name: Honeybuzz
prompts.prompt: A small round bee-like creature with fuzzy golden-and-green stripes and translucent wings, trailing a faint sweet-smelling glimmer of pollen.

prompts.name: Thornet
prompts.prompt: A leaner wasp-like creature with sharper golden-green banding and a visible thorn-shaped stinger, wings buzzing with quicker, sharper energy.

prompts.name: Barbnet
prompts.prompt: A sleeker wasp with deep green-and-gold banding and a longer, barbed thorn-stinger, wings edged faintly translucent-violet, poised and quick.

prompts.name: Venomnet
prompts.prompt: A striking wasp with bold dark-green armoured banding and a wicked curved stinger dripping faint toxin-glow, wings a blur of violet-tinted motion.

prompts.name: Hivemonarch
prompts.prompt: A commanding hive-sovereign wasp in deep emerald-and-gold armoured banding, a huge curved glowing stinger and wings that shimmer violet-green, radiating quiet, absolute authority over every smaller stinger nearby.

prompts.name: Nibblet
prompts.prompt: A small round rat creature with bright inquisitive eyes and cheeks visibly stuffed full, sandy-brown fur and a long curious tail, clutching a shiny pebble.

prompts.name: Gnawglint
prompts.prompt: A slightly bigger rat with a glinting, alert gleam in its eye and even fuller cheeks, sandy-brown fur, sorting a small pile of shiny trinkets.

prompts.name: Hoardrat
prompts.prompt: A stocky, well-fed rat with rich earthy-brown fur and a small mound of hoarded shinies always nearby, whiskers twitching with constant appraisal.

prompts.name: Vaultgnaw
prompts.prompt: A hefty, burly rat with thick digging claws and dense umber fur, small glints of buried treasure caught in its fur, radiating the quiet confidence of a creature that owns a lot of tunnels.

prompts.name: Coinlord
prompts.prompt: A magnificently plump rat-sovereign draped in a rattling mantle of found coins, buttons and polished stones, deep umber-gold fur and sharp glinting eyes, sitting like royalty atop its own hoard.
